title: Propositional Logic
summary: Propositions, connectives and truth tables: the same Boolean logic your CPU, your if-statements and every search engine run on.

title: Predicate Logic and Quantifiers
summary: Variables, predicates, ∀ and ∃. Precise specifications for programs and queries, from SQL WHERE clauses to API contracts.

title: Reasoning and Proof
summary: Rules of inference and proof techniques. How to be certain, and how verified software and theorem provers make machines certain too.

title: Sets, Relations and Functions
summary: The data types of mathematics: sets, relations, functions, sequences, and the surprising sizes of infinity.

title: Induction, Recursion and Counting
summary: Prove things for every n, reason about recursive code, and count possibilities without listing them.

title: Graphs and Trees
summary: Networks, maps, schedules and file systems. Model the connected world and color it without conflicts.
